summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a UK-style Total Voting Rights announcement, the US-equivalent of a routine share-count disclosure under the FCA Disclosure and Transparency Rules. As of 30 October 2026, 199,097,008 ordinary shares of 0.01 pence were in issue with none held in treasury, giving total voting rights of 199,097,008, usable by holders as the denominator for interest notifications. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor opinion is stated. The company remains a tungsten explorer listed on NYSE American and AIM; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
